recent_posts.title: How to Convert JSON to Excel in Seconds
recent_posts.summary: Xcel is a tool that converts JSON files to Excel format instantly. Users can upload or paste JSON data, and the tool automatically transforms even complex nested structures into clean Excel spreadsheets without manual formatting or parsing. The tool is particularly useful for reporting, debugging, and sharing data with non-technical team members.

recent_posts.title: How Dynamic URLs Help You Test Content at Scale
recent_posts.summary: Dynamic URLs enable on-the-fly media transformations through URL parameters, allowing teams to create multiple variants of images and videos from a single file. This approach eliminates the need to generate and store multiple versions, enabling faster experimentation with resizing, cropping, filtering, and text overlays without requiring file uploads or developer intervention.

recent_posts.title: Pixel Quiz, Save your Time.
recent_posts.summary: Pixel Quiz Generator is an AI-powered tool that automatically converts PDF documents and text notes into interactive quizzes with multiple choice questions and short answers. The platform uses Gemini AI and AI agents to streamline quiz creation for educators, featuring a retro pixel-art crypto theme interface.

recent_posts.title: Adding GraphQL Flexibility to Your Existing APIs
recent_posts.summary: Modern applications use multiple API types (REST, gRPC, GraphQL) each with distinct advantages, but managing all three creates complexity and integration challenges. REST provides simple external interfaces, gRPC enables high-performance internal service communication, and GraphQL unifies client access while reducing endpoint coupling. Complete GraphQL migration is costly and risky, but Grafbase offers a solution to extend existing APIs with GraphQL capabilities without disrupting current systems.

recent_posts.title: Stay Awake - Need a quick coffee break ☕?
recent_posts.summary: Stay Awake is a web application that prevents computers from going to sleep by keeping a browser tab active in the foreground. It uses the Screen Wake Lock API to maintain system activity without changing power settings, solving the common problem of returning to locked screens after short breaks. The app includes additional productivity widgets like a clock, battery status, to-do list, and Pomodoro timer, and works as an installable PWA with local preference storage.

recent_posts.title: Using Digital Avatars to Attract Talent
recent_posts.summary: AI digital avatars are emerging as an alternative to traditional hiring methods, offering potential solutions to lengthy interviews, high costs, and logistical challenges. Companies like Dropbox and Starbucks have adopted video recruitment to showcase work environments and values. Successful implementation requires setting clear objectives, selecting appropriate avatar personalities, generating tailored interview questions, integrating realistic audio interactions, and continuous testing and iteration.

recent_posts.title: A web-based budget tracker to manage expenses efficiently.
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares their experience building a personal budget tracker web application to manage expenses more efficiently. The project evolved from a simple idea into a full-featured expense management tool that helps streamline financial tracking and organization.

recent_posts.title: 6 Common Postgres Beginner Mistakes and Best Practices
recent_posts.summary: Starting with Postgres can be challenging due to common beginner mistakes such as misunderstanding VACUUM, not closing connections, inefficient queries, neglecting primary keys, and ignoring backup importance. Knowing why these errors occur and learning strategies to prevent them can help improve your Postgres experience.

recent_posts.title: Side benefit of Tanstack in React:
recent_posts.summary: Using Tanstack Query in React can eliminate the need for prop drilling or managing separate state stores when sibling components need to access the same data. It prevents duplicate network requests by allowing components to share data efficiently.

recent_posts.title: Why Technical Interviews Feel Broken - and How to Stop Failing Them
recent_posts.summary: Technical interviews can be challenging for even skilled developers due to their pressure-filled format. The post suggests vocal practice, simulating interview pressure, and reflecting on past experiences as strategies to improve performance. Interviews should be seen as a skill to be honed, not a judgment of one's ability.
